disclosure.grid: Native derived regular grid reconstructed from compressed samples; bad quality becomes null; no gap filling performed by this service.
disclosure.raw: Primary irregular compressed recorded samples; quality retained.

actual_native_validation_report.name: not_trivially_detectable
actual_native_validation_report.detail: 1 subtle episodes checked; none beaten by a 3-sigma threshold
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: If a moving-window variance one-liner finds the fault instantly, the dataset is too easy and every downstream result is worthless.

actual_native_validation_report.name: solvable
actual_native_validation_report.detail: 6 episodes assessed; all have discriminating evidence that moves
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: Guarantees the diagnosis is reachable. Without it the dataset can fail by being impossible rather than hard, and a wrong answer is the data's fault rather than the method's.

actual_native_validation_report.name: physical_bounds
actual_native_validation_report.detail: all tags inside their declared range
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: A transmitter clamps at its range; values outside it are impossible.

actual_native_validation_report.name: no_range_clamping
actual_native_validation_report.detail: no plant transmitter pinned at its range limit
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: A clamped reading hides the excursion; size the range to the duty.

actual_native_validation_report.name: mass_balance
actual_native_validation_report.detail: clean-baseline bias +0.000 % of feed, residual sd 0.0188
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: Real balances nearly close but not quite. Exact closure is a tell; gross non-closure is an error.

actual_native_validation_report.name: control_variance_ratio
actual_native_validation_report.detail: TIC-201: OP/PV span-normalised sd ratio 7.2; LIC-201: OP/PV span-normalised sd ratio 0.5
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: Information lives in the manipulated variable. Fouling shows as a valve slowly opening while the temperature stays perfect. A loop whose PV stays within 0.5 % of span is holding whatever its output does.

actual_native_validation_report.name: noise_is_colored
actual_native_validation_report.detail: median 1/e autocorrelation time by class: flow 30s, level 90s, power 50s, pressure 20s, temperature 190s, temperature_slow 415s
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: A thermowell low-passes the process, a DP cell does not. One noise model across all tags is a giveaway.

actual_native_validation_report.name: transport_lag
actual_native_validation_report.detail: FI-203: declared 60s, measured 50s; TI-203: declared 120s, measured 170s; AI-201: declared 480s, measured 700s
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: Synthetic data usually correlates instantaneously; real data does not.

actual_native_validation_report.name: pca_dimensionality
actual_native_validation_report.detail: 15 components explain 95 % of clean-baseline variance across 30 tags
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: Effective dimensionality far below or above the tag count is a tell.

actual_native_validation_report.name: historian_irregularity
actual_native_validation_report.detail: overall retention 12.0 %, worst pairwise timestamp overlap 31 %
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: Per-tag deadbands give every tag a different timestamp set, which is what forces explicit resampling and reproduces real exports.

actual_native_validation_report.name: frozen_values
actual_native_validation_report.detail: 22 tags contain frozen stretches over 300 tag-months; 0 frozen samples carry a bad-quality flag (must be 0)
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: A stuck transmitter reports good quality. Finding it is part of the exercise, so nothing may mark it.

actual_native_validation_report.name: correlated_dropouts
actual_native_validation_report.detail: 5 nodes fail as a group, 0 fail tag-by-tag (27.0 outages expected)
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: Instruments do not fail independently. A DCS node drops and every tag on it goes bad at the same instant.

actual_native_validation_report.name: no_fault_twin
actual_native_validation_report.detail: 31 real tags diverge after the first onset; ballast differing: 0; pre-onset differing: 0
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: Ballast and the pre-onset period share everything with the twin, so they must match bit for bit. Anything else means the RNG is coupled and the twin is not a controlled comparison.

actual_native_validation_report.name: baseline_settled
actual_native_validation_report.detail: every loop PV opens at its steady value
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: A transient at the head of the training window is learned as normal.

actual_native_validation_report.name: recipe
actual_native_validation_report.detail: rca-benchmark: 9 unique faults, 2 benign, baseline 14 d, gaps >= 2 d
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: One window, one label: a benchmark scored on root cause cannot repeat a cause, a mechanism or a failed component, or let two explanations share data.

actual_native_validation_report.name: dataset_layout
actual_native_validation_report.detail: folder holds exactly the documented files
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: The dataset is the historian files, tag list, process description and answer key.

actual_native_validation_report.name: no_answer_leak
actual_native_validation_report.detail: process description and tag list name no cause or event
actual_native_validation_report.rationale: A list of things that can go wrong is half an answer. The process description and tag list describe the plant, never what goes wrong.

scope: Actual completed native job, unchanged pass/fail findings and public hashes. No press qualification or EKAS deployment readiness is inferred; private answer keys are omitted.
